name: pokerogue-vita
description: Unofficial PS Vita homebrew client for PokeRogue (beta): plays the live game online with cloud saves, or offline, in an embedded QuickJS runtime with native rendering
long_description: An unofficial PlayStation Vita homebrew client for PokeRogue. It runs the **live pokerogue.net game**, which means automatic updates, online accounts and cloud saves, much like the online mode of Admiral-Billy's PokeRogue App on desktop and Android. It can also play an offline build of the game from the memory card.
